summary: The audit checks 20 units of MS&E courses numbered 200 or higher (cross-listed courses count), at least two of them MS&E 300-level doctoral courses, and at least 16 letter-graded units. Checked by hand: a 3.3 GPA in the letter-graded units, and that your courses form a coherent program with breadth across the department.

ADRkeFOp.why: "20 units of MS&E courses, or courses cross-listed as MS&E courses, numbered 200 or higher." A cross-listed course carries an MS&E listing, which the pool matches.

z6MNrqBd.why: "Within the overall 20 units for the PhD Minor, there must be a minimum of two MS&E 300-level courses (doctoral courses)." They are part of the 20 units, so they share.

tLg3b8rc.why: "Within the overall 20 units for the PhD Minor, there must be a minimum of 16 letter-graded units, with a minimum grade point average of 3.3 in these courses." The 16 letter-graded units are now a program total; the GPA is checked by hand.

patch.name: GPA of 3.3 in the letter-graded units

nGvzd8m8.why: "The courses approved for the PhD Minor should form a coherent program, and include a breadth of courses from across the department."

totals.why: "Within the overall 20 units for the PhD Minor, there must be a minimum of 16 letter-graded units, with a minimum grade point average of 3.3 in these courses."
